description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Greenwarden of Murasa
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
